item.title: k-Nearest-Neighbour Search with <->
item.description: “Find the closest N things to here” is a one-line ORDER BY in PostgreSQL — and with a GiST index it answers in microseconds.

item.title: A Map With No Graphics Library
item.description: Bin points into a grid, count them, and encode density as Braille height-bar characters — four dot-fill levels on fixed thresholds, and PostgreSQL draws a recognizable map straight into the query result.
